Self-Improve 2.2.0 introduces a clearer framework overview and improved setup instructions.

- Expanded documentation with detailed usage, memory tiers, and workflow explanations.

- Enhanced description of when and how self-improvement runs (cron, manual, post-event).

- Specified dependencies and approval workflow for proposed improvements.
